properties.description:
Placeable crafting station. Crafts Pillow Armor Helmet, Pillow Armor Chestplate, Pillow Armor Leggings and Work Gloves. Dismantle with a Reinforced Screwdriver Tool. Upgradable with a Heavy-Duty Hammer Tool into the Advanced Armor Bench.
Basic armor crafting bench. Create light armor and basic protection gear.
